items.title: Howmet Aerospace Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: Howmet Aerospace (NYSE:HWM) reported second-quarter results that exceeded the high end of its guidance, driven by continued growth in commercial aerospace, gas turbines and defense markets. The company also raised its full-year outlook for revenue, EBITDA, earnings per share and free cash flow. Rev
